hero.title: Biotechnology
hero.subtitle: Pursue innovative Biotechnology degrees in Finland, offering state-of-the-art laboratory facilities, bio-informatics training, and advanced biomaterials research. Gain globally competitive expertise in health biotechnology and environmental bio-processes in a research-intensive educational system.

overview: Biotechnology in Finland is an excellent study option for Indian students interested in life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food technology, environmental science and industrial innovation. Finland offers internationally recognised Biotechnology courses with strong research and practical components, including English-taught master's programmes at Aalto University and the University of Helsinki.

Students can develop expertise in molecular biology, microbiology, bioinformatics, bioprocessing, drug development and biomanufacturing, preparing for careers in biotechnology companies, pharmaceutical industries, research organisations and academia.
